name: hyperfamily-branch-monitor
description: Secure Windows desktop monitoring and inventory application for HyperFamily retail branches.
author: Ali Ajeli Lahiji

scripts.build:electron: npm run compile:electron && npm run build:agent && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
scripts.test:database: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:tests && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron --test tests/database.electron-test.js
scripts.test:ssh: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:tests && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron --test tests/ssh-kex.electron-test.js
scripts.test:vpn: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:tests && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron --test tests/vpn-connect.electron-test.js
scripts.test:template: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:tests && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron --test tests/import-template.electron-test.js
scripts.build:recovery: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:renderer && npm --prefix electron/recovery install && electron-builder --config electron-builder.recovery.json --publish never
scripts.test:agent: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:tests && node --test tests/unit/agent-windows.test.js
scripts.version:bump: npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:scripts && node scripts/bump-version.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile:all && c8 --reporter=text-summary node --test tests/unit/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.compile:all: npm run compile:config && npm run compile:scripts && npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:renderer && npm run compile:tests
scripts.predev:electron: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:renderer
scripts.prestart: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:renderer
scripts.prerecovery: npm run compile:vendor && npm run compile:electron && npm run compile:renderer
